messages:
eva: quick sync — I'm about to open the structured-output / function-calling toggle for the API surface. need to confirm canary audiences + rollback guardrails before i flip anything. TL;DR: small progressive exposure, client-compat checks, hard kill switch.

sam: sounds good. what are we considering for the initial audience? 1% global? eng-only? :eyes:

maria: prefer 5% internal first (eng + SEs) so we catch integration regressions. 1% is tiny and noisy for low-volume endpoints. also suggest sampling by route: only outbound /chat and /generate routes, not rerank or bulk-embed.

raj: SDK note — older clients (<=v1.2.0) don't understand the new `so_mode` field. we need server-side compat: default `so_mode: off` for unversioned SDKs, and add a header `X-Client-Version` gating rule.

lucy: rollback guardrails idea: 1) automatic rollback if error-rate on canary > 3x baseline for 5m window, 2) disable for users with SLO-critical tags, 3) manual emergency toggle in console + slack alerting channel.

maria: also add a quality gate: if hallucination metric (eval set) drifts > 4% vs baseline we pause rollout. we have the eval harness in CI that can run against canary logs.

eva: agreed on those gates. proposal: Phase A = 5% internal routes for 24h. Phase B = 10% beta orgs (opt-in) for 48h. Phase C = 25% randomized traffic excluding SLO-critical customers. final rollout after 7d stable.

sam: how do we implement the audience selection? rollout-service supports `audience:id` + `route:regex`, right? can we do a predicate: `client_version >= 1.3.0 OR flagged_user`?

raj: yes. sample snippet for the flag rule: ```json
{
  "flag": "so_func_calling_v2",
  "rules": [
    {"predicate": "request.route =~ /chat|generate/", "sample": 0.05, "audience": "internal"},
    {"predicate": "client.version >= 1.3.0", "sample": 0.10, "audience": "beta"}
  ],
  "fallback": {"so_mode": "off"}
}
```

lucy: make sure the rollout-service emits `rollout-event` to `#so-rollouts` and `incidents` when the automatic rollback triggers. also we need a dashboard widget for token-latency and error-rate for the canary bucket.

deploy-bot: deploy-checklist: lint flags ✅, rollout policy uploaded ✅, smoke tests queued ✅, canary dashboards linked ✅.

eva: next steps: raj to add server-side header gating + fallback, maria to wire eval harness alerts, lucy to create dashboard and incident webhook, sam to draft the opt-in beta announcement for partners. i'll schedule the flip for Friday 10am PT if all green. anyone object? :shipit:

sam: no objections. will ping partners.

maria: i'll post the eval alert thresholds in this thread once wired.

raj: starting the header gating PR now, will link in 15m.

eva: thanks all — i'll hold the flip until we see the PR + dashboards linked. if anything blocks, escalate in #oncall.
